# localViewer

A local-first, install-free file viewer for Markdown, YAML, CSV, STL, 3MF, STEP, OpenSCAD, glTF/GLB and image files. No files are uploaded to any server — all processing happens in your browser.

## Key features

- **Privacy-first**: Files never leave your browser. No uploads, no servers, no tracking.
- **Offline-first**: Works completely offline after first load (PWA).
- **Multi-format support**: Markdown (with RTL/LTR auto-align), YAML trees, CSV tables, STL/3MF/STEP/glTF/GLB 3D models, OpenSCAD compilation, and images.
- **Built-in editor**: Edit and save Markdown files directly.
- **Windows integration**: Register "Open with → localViewer" for file types.

## Technical notes

- Static single-page app (no build step).
- Loaders: marked, js-yaml, three.js (STL/3MF via ThreeMFLoader, glTF/GLB via GLTFLoader), occt-import-js (STEP), openscad-wasm.
- Three.js WebGL viewer for 3D geometry.
- Full support for 3MF multi-part slicer projects (Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer).
